title: 11.11.2022. KriptoEarn - Important announcement
notes: Primary source for the temporary pause, disabled new deposits, planned transfer of principal and rewards through 10 November to regular wallets, partner-risk explanation, and Kriptomat's statement that it had no liquidity issue.

title: KriptoEarn Staking Services Terms of Use
notes: Version 4.0 states that users remain sole owners of qualified virtual currencies while authorizing Kriptomat to use them for protocol staking, subject to protocol-specific deposit and withdrawal periods, dynamic rewards, fees, and service suspension rights.

title: Kriptomat to Wind Down Operations by 30 June 2026
notes: Primary source for the withdrawn MiCA authorisation application, planned 30 June cessation, claimed solvency and withdrawal availability, Kraken transition option, and continued support for residual obligations.

title: Kriptomat wind-down information hub
notes: Current first-party hub marks the phase terminating KriptoEarn positions and the 30 June service deadline as completed, states that assets were moved to main wallets, and describes read-only and manual withdrawal treatment for residual accounts.

title: Kriptomat Terms of Service during wind-down
notes: Current terms describe cessation of regulated services after 30 June 2026, residual administration and asset-return activities, service restrictions, inactive-account and manual-processing fees, and continued compliance checks during wind-down.
